title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 45
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 45: the short message for Baruch the son of Neriah, his complaint and the promise about his life.

questions.text: To whom did Jeremiah the prophet speak this message?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 45:1 says this was the message that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch the son of Neriah.

answers.text: To Zedekiah king of Judah
To Baruch the son of Neriah
To Jehoiakim the son of Josiah
To Seraiah the chief priest

questions.text: What had Baruch done when this message came to him?
questions.explanation: He had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah.

answers.text: He had read the book aloud in the temple courts
He had carried the book to Babylon by night
He had hidden the book in a field near the city
He had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah

questions.text: In which year is this message dated?
questions.explanation: It came in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah.

answers.text: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah
In the first year of Zedekiah king of Judah
In the tenth year of Josiah king of Judah
In the eleventh year of Jehoiakim king of Judah

questions.text: Who is named as the one speaking to Baruch in verse 2?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says: Yahweh, the God of Israel, says to you, Baruch.

answers.text: Neriah, his father
Jehoiakim, the king of Judah
Yahweh, the God of Israel
The priests of Jerusalem

questions.text: What had Baruch said Yahweh had added to his pain?
questions.explanation: Baruch had said: Woe is me now! For Yahweh has added sorrow to my pain.

answers.text: Shame
Sorrow
Sickness
Long years

questions.text: What did Baruch say about his groaning?
questions.explanation: He said he was weary with his groaning and found no rest.

answers.text: That it had turned into singing
That Yahweh had not heard it
That it troubled him only in the night
That he was weary with it and found no rest

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he would do with that which he had built?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says: that which I have built, I will break down.

answers.text: He would make it greater
He would give it to Baruch
He would break it down
He would leave it standing

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he would do with that which he had planted?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says that what he had planted he would pluck up, and this in the whole land.

answers.text: He would pluck it up
He would water it
He would fence it in
He would give its fruit to the nations

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell Baruch about seeking great things for himself?
questions.explanation: Yahweh asks whether he seeks great things for himself and tells him not to seek them.

answers.text: To seek them with all his heart
Not to seek them
To seek them only in Judah
To seek them after the evil had passed

questions.text: What did Yahweh promise Baruch at the end of the message?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he would bring evil on all flesh, but would let Baruch escape with his life wherever he went.

answers.text: That he would be made a prince in Judah
That he would see Jerusalem rebuilt in his days
That he would never be weary or groan again
That he would let him escape with his life wherever he went
